label: ITS
description: GIC ITS (Interrupt Translation Service) 寄存器

registers.name: GITS_STATUSR
registers.description: ITS Error Reporting Status Register。GIC ITS 寄存器。

fields.name: Syndrome
fields.description: Syndrome for the MSI that set GITS_STATUSR.UMSI to 1. An implementation might not support reporting all syndromes, and might report 0b0000 for any cause. This field is UNKNOWN when GITS_STATUSR.UMSI is 0. [0b0000=; 0b0010=; 0b0011=; 0b0100=; 0b0101=; 0b0111=; 0b1001=]

fields.name: Overflow
fields.description: Reports whether an unmapped MSI has been received while GITS_STATUSR.UMSI is 1. A software write of 1 to the bit clears it. A write of any other value is ignored. If GITS_TYPER.UMSI is 0, this field is RES0. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: UMSI
fields.description: Reports whether an unmapped MSI has been received An unmapped MSI is defined as an MSI arriving at GITS_TRANSLATER for which there is insufficient mapping information for it to be forwarded to a Redistributor. It is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether an INT command can be reported as an unmapped MSI. A software write of 1 to the bit clears it. A write of any other value is ignored. If GITS_TYPER.UMSI is 0, this field is RES0. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: WROD
fields.description: Write to an RO location. When a violation is detected, software must write 1 to this register to reset it. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: RWOD
fields.description: Read of a WO location. When a violation is detected, software must write 1 to this register to reset it. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: WRD
fields.description: Write to a reserved location. When a violation is detected, software must write 1 to this register to reset it. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: RRD
fields.description: Read of a reserved location. When a violation is detected, software must write 1 to this register to reset it. [0b0=; 0b1=]
